scope: Post-hoc detector diagnostics only; never used by production decisions.

historical_operating_point.shelf_failure: Thousands of aggregate detections with approximately 0.003 association accuracy

screw_root_cause.final_result: DETECTION_MISS caused by LOW_CONFIDENCE_FILTER, not NMS, max_det, crop removal, depth refinement, stage-volume gating, or tracking

f0_low_threshold_probe.explanation: The only physical screw hypothesis was removed during cross-label physical dedup; no correct screw association survived even below the frozen threshold.

screw_root_cause.exact_fix_attempted: Direct screw class, calibrated crop enlargement, optional generic tiling trial, global threshold study, refined RGB-D support, and physical dedup.
screw_root_cause.remaining_limitation: Official zero-shot YOLO-World does not assign useful screw confidence or correct physical association in the frozen rendered domain.

bolt_root_cause.remaining_limitation: Below-threshold bolt hypotheses are semantic false positives rather than useful bolt detections.

shelf_root_cause.historical: Very low threshold admitted widespread shelf hallucinations without adequate physical association weighting.
shelf_root_cause.exact_fix_attempted: Global confidence/NMS calibration, cross-scale physical dedup, gated-point reuse, association-quality weighting, and one winning region hypothesis per camera/stage.
shelf_root_cause.remaining_limitation: The aggregate count is substantially cleaner per image but shelf remains an uncontrolled YOLO semantic confusion and is not solved.
